location: Yan Yean Road Upgrade project office (Yarrambat/Doreen), Melbourne VIC
cover_letter_text:
Hi McConnell Dowell team,

I'm Marc, and I'd like to start as a junior project engineer. I have a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019), and I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Your Yan Yean Road Upgrade role covers the full project, not just one discipline, so I wanted to apply.

On two building sites in the Philippines, from April 2019 to February 2020, I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, tracked procurement and carried out safety and quality checks. My road design coursework covered the Austroads guides and AS 1742.14.

I'm based in Melton with my own transport, I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), and I can start two weeks after an offer. I'd be happy to come in for a chat.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
